_comment: Copy this file to appsettings.json (or appsettings.Production.json) and replace every <REPLACE_ME> placeholder before starting the backend outside of throwaway local dev. Secrets can also come from `*_FILE` siblings — see README for the Docker Compose secrets flow.

Storage._: Adaptive presigned URL expiry — base + sizeGB * perGb, hard-capped at MinIO's 7-day ceiling.
Storage._legacy: Fallback static expiry used when UseAdaptiveExpiry=false. DownloadUrlExpirySeconds is optional; when null/0 it inherits from the upload value.
Storage._verify: Integrity gate: before an artifact is accepted (and the job allowed to complete) the backend re-reads the object from MinIO and re-hashes SHA256 against the agent-reported checksum. ChecksumVerifyMaxBytes (null = no cap) skips the re-hash for objects larger than the given size; existence + size are still verified.

Retention._: How often the background retention sweep prunes artifacts that exceed their policy's RetentionDays / RetentionMaxCount / RetentionMaxTotalBytes rules.

Jwt._: Optional dedicated key for agent JWTs. When set, rotating it does not invalidate user sessions. Must differ from SigningKey and be >= 32 bytes.

Cors._: Required in Production — backend refuses to start with an empty or loopback origin list.
